Addition with overflow check via require(c >= a).
Subtraction with underflow check via require(b <= a).
Multiplication with overflow check via c / a == b.
Division with require(b > 0) guard.
Raw addition c = a + b; overflow only mitigated by the following require.
Raw subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Raw multiplication c = a * b guarded by a == 0 || c / a == b.
Raw division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) before the credit; classic CEI violation window in a token transfer.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) credits an attacker-controlled address.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) relies on safeSub reverting on underflow as an implicit allowance check.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) decrements the spender allowance.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) credits an arbitrary destination address.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens overwrites the allowance with no zero-first pattern, enabling allowance race/front-running.
balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply mints the whole supply to the deployer without event-free verification.
